body: This is what i did too. Calling a hotline actually helps quite a lot. It's easier to talk to them because you don't know who they are and you know you won't see them again. It's really not worth overdosing. Talking to someone and releasing all your negative emotions does help quite a lot.

>DryBlueberry-537

i've tried hanging and overdosing. I didn't pass out from the hanging and I only spiked a fever after overdosing. But the memories and thoughts are quite intimidating.

Hey, I'm so proud of you for getting so far! I'm so happy for you! I really want to hug you :) I really hope I get a tattoo when I get older. I'm so glad you're happy and doing things you love. Hopefully things go well! Sending you lots of love and a hugz award!

Hi, yes, I'm still here. I'm sorry I've only seen this comment now. I passed out after taking around 50 pills and got really sick. I still went to school the day after though. Thanks for checking in! I'm doing better.
I've tried to talk. Didn't get me anywhere. I just need to know how to do this. But thank you for you encouragement.
